messages:
sam: Quick thread  design/UX review for a few API key experiments: bulk-rotate preview, role-bound templates, and a soft-expire particle for keys (shows countdown + undo). Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/ui/creds-experiments-2198888888.png

maria: Nice variety. My top concern is cognitive load in the key list if we surface countdowns and templates. Maybe collapse into a single metadata row with a chevron to expand details? :thinking_face:

lee: From infra side: rendering timers for hundreds of keys per page is bad for perf. If we show countdowns, we should only animate visible rows (IntersectionObserver) and otherwise show static ETA text. Also bulk-rotate preview (dry-run) is cheap server-side but we need an API flag ?dry_run=true.

ada: Accessibility notes: countdowns must not be live-announced every second. Use an aria-live region that updates only on major state changes (e.g., when it hits 1 minute left). For the expand/collapse, ensure aria-expanded toggles and provide an accessible label for the metadata chevron.

sam: UX proposal: default collapsed list with a small meta line: "Expires in 3d • Template: read-only". Clicking expands shows full countdown, rotate button, and audit link. For soft-expire, instead of immediate delete, show yellow banner with "Expire now" + "Extend 7d".

maria: Copy suggestion for the banner: "Key set to expire in 24 hours. Extend or expire now." CTA verbs: Keep primary as "Extend 7 days" and secondary "Expire now" (danger). That should lower accidental deletes.

lee: For bulk rotate UI: show a two-column dry-run table: key name vs predicted new policy (scopes/roles). Add a per-key checkbox to exclude from rotate. Action should return a job id and per-key status. UI should surface partial failures.

ada: A11y for the rotate job: when job completes, announce summary via role="status" with aria-live="polite": "Bulk rotate finished: 12 succeeded, 3 failed." For per-key failure rows, ensure error text is programmatically associated with the row (aria-describedby).

sam: Another microcopy debate: in templates dropdown, label option as "Role-bound template (recommended)" vs just "Template". I think the explicitness helps non-admins. Thoughts?

maria: I like the explicit version. Also add a hover tooltip: "Templates lock scopes to a role; admins can override."

lee: Security note: templates that are role-bound must be enforced server-side. We should include a server error code like 409.TEMPLATE_CONFLICT if someone attempts to grant extra scopes. UI should surface that cleanly.

ada: Keyboard flow tests: ensure expand/collapse is reachable via Enter/Space on the chevron, check that the rotate modal (or panel) traps focus correctly, and that the undo action for soft-expire is focusable before the countdown auto-commits. I'll add these to the a11y ticket.

sam: Action items: (1) I'll update mocks with collapsed meta row + expand animation and non-animating ETA fallback. (2) @lee add dry_run param and job contract to the API spec. (3) @ada write the a11y acceptance for live regions, chevron semantics, and error associations. (4) @maria finalize copy for banners and template labels.

auditor-bot: FYI audit: bulk-rotate dry-run output will be logged to /audit/bulk-rotate/{job_id}.json for compliance.

maria: Let's A/B test soft-expire vs immediate expiry for revoked keys (small cohort). If soft-expire reduces support tickets, we keep it. :sparkles:

sam: Great, will push updated PNG + Loom keyboard demo later today. Thanks!
